title: Release QUEST gate accepts failed tasks and unrelated historical events

evidence.note: Actual original Q01 and Q02 callbacks both fail contract counterexamples: 0/2, exit1. Live T107 failed after original60s request abort.

trigger_path: Dispatch returns failed with persisted multistep plan; Q01 checks only plan size/id. Q02 counts any recent workspace session instead of the new thread. Forced alphabetic preset is unrelated to the normal goal route.

assertions.given: One normal QUEST dispatch and exact thread plus failed/paused/queued/errored/unverified/malformed responses, current receipts and matching approval join
assertions.expect: Reject false completion and unrelated events; retain normal semantic route and finite single request; read current progress, exact session and verified distinct steps; guarded review remains pending and requires usable matching approval snapshot.

fix_plan: Extract strict release QUEST proof helper, use normal dispatch route once within measured planner budget, and bind event/approval query to the exact new thread. Never retry dispatch or disable execution bridges/fences.
blast_radius: Local experiment release tooling only; no base planner, task execution, approval, customer data or provider behavior change.
rollback: Revert gate helper and wiring; preserve all failed thread/event/approval archives and keep release blocked until valid current receipts exist.
notes: Source-only red/green tests do not prove live release chains. Full live gate requires official final-source payload and original native authentication.
